projects.name: MAPLE
projects.desc: Compresses 26B AI reasoning models by 52% to run entirely on ordinary 6GB laptop GPUs at 45 words/second with zero cloud servers.
projects.long: Large language models usually require massive cloud clusters. MAPLE removes dormant neural pathways from Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, shrinking Gemma 4 26B from 9.92 GB down to 4.75 GB. The compressed model runs 100% inside consumer laptop GPU memory at 45.4 tokens per second while preserving mathematical and coding intelligence. Reached 65+ GitHub stars and 300+ downloads within 24 hours of release.

projects.name: VoxelNav
projects.desc: Real-time 3D spatial vision for delivery robots, processing laser scans and depth cameras in 42 milliseconds on a $99 edge computer.
projects.long: Autonomous delivery rovers and drones need to see in 3D without lagging or crashing. VoxelNav converts raw depth and LiDAR laser scans into an intelligent 3D voxel grid at 42.8ms per frame on a Jetson Nano, well below the 100ms real-time budget. Built with C++20 and ROS2 to steer rovers around unexpected obstacles in real time.

projects.name: Decision Analytics Engine
projects.desc: Enterprise analytics engine discovering optimal product pricing, customer retention, and operating cash float across 50,000 transactions.
projects.long: Stops businesses from guessing price discounts and ad spend. Combines causal machine learning (Double ML) with game-theoretic pricing models to pinpoint the exact profit-maximizing price without churning customers, while stress-testing operating cash conversion cycles across 50,000 enterprise records.

projects.name: Latency Engine
projects.desc: High-frequency trading engine capturing price differences between crypto exchanges in under 800 nanoseconds using lock-free C++20.
projects.long: When asset prices diverge across exchanges, this engine captures delta-neutral arbitrage before other market participants can react. Processes 2.4 million price updates per second with an ultra-low tick-to-trade latency of 780 nanoseconds using zero-copy memory buffers.

projects.name: GhostPilot
projects.desc: Autonomous drone navigation system that flies through GPS-denied indoor buildings and tunnels using onboard vision and AI commands.
projects.long: Drones normally crash when GPS signals drop indoors or underground. GhostPilot uses camera odometry (VINS-Mono) and an onboard AI planner to translate high-level commands like 'inspect corridor B' into collision-free flight paths without any satellite fix.

projects.name: KVQuant
projects.desc: Memory compressor allowing huge 70-billion parameter AI models to run on ordinary laptops with 8GB RAM without crashing.
projects.long: Long conversations with AI models usually eat up 28GB of memory and crash regular laptops. KVQuant compresses conversational memory by 6.8x down to 4.1GB on the fly, unlocking 32,000-token context windows on everyday personal computers.

projects.name: Middleout Lattice
projects.desc: Next-generation lossless data compressor that shrinks files 12% smaller than industry standards Zstandard and Brotli in pure C++.
projects.long: Shrinks large text and database files smaller than the world's most popular compression algorithms (Zstd L22 and Brotli L11) by using multi-scale predictive context modeling and carry-free range coding.

projects.name: StegaChirp
projects.desc: Converts confidential computer files into inaudible ultrasonic sound waves to transmit data through the air without Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
projects.long: Transmits secret data across air-gapped rooms using frequency-shift keyed ultrasonic audio above 19.5 kHz. Inaudible to human ears, written in 100% pure Python standard library with zero third-party dependencies.

projects.name: Unlimited OCR
projects.desc: Private, 100% offline document scanner that converts PDFs, scans, and financial tables into editable text with zero cloud privacy risk.
projects.long: Scans up to 48 pages per second on your local computer. Extracts tables, text columns, and bounding boxes completely air-gapped without sending sensitive personal or financial documents to cloud APIs.

projects.name: Attempt 3D Engine
projects.desc: Complete 3D game engine and zombie survival shooter built from scratch in pure C++ inside a microscopic 398KB file.
projects.long: Contains a custom software rasterizer, 3D math library, perspective textures, and Z-buffering with zero external libraries or game engines. Runs locked at 60 FPS purely on the CPU.

projects.name: KernelWeave
projects.desc: Self-compiling skill compiler that turns repetitive AI agent workflows into reusable high-speed software code.
projects.long: Observes autonomous AI agent execution paths, synthesizes the repetitive steps into compiled Python kernels, and caches them for 10x faster execution.

projects.name: SignalHop
projects.desc: Ultra-lightweight signal router and telemetry pipeline for streaming sensor data across distributed devices.
projects.long: High-throughput, low-latency telemetry routing tool connecting edge IoT sensors with central analytics dashboards with sub-millisecond queuing.

projects.name: Nexus
projects.desc: Automated open-source intelligence engine mapping connections across public online data sources.
projects.long: Gathers, correlates, and analyzes public signals across decentralized platforms, building interactive entity graphs for security researchers.

projects.name: Lingua
projects.desc: Fast document translation agent translating 600-page books and PDFs while keeping every chart and layout pixel-perfect.
projects.long: Solves broken formatting during PDF translation. Parses complex multi-column documents and reconstructs them in target languages with exact typographic spacing.

projects.name: Munchkin AI
projects.desc: Autonomous desktop companion AI with human-like memory that observes, remembers, and assists during daily computer work.
projects.long: Implements continuous perception and episodic memory consolidation, allowing a local AI companion to recall past user interactions without cloud databases.

projects.name: Diplomatic Embeddings
projects.desc: Geopolitical intelligence engine analyzing thousands of UN treaties to predict international voting patterns.
projects.long: Applies vector embeddings and stance mining to multilateral international treaties, identifying policy alignments and negotiating leverage points.

projects.name: SwarmDraft
projects.desc: Decentralized battery-aware auction protocol assigning jobs to autonomous robot teams without a central server.
projects.long: Prevents robot swarms from running out of battery during warehouse and search missions by using deterministic game-theoretic bidding among robots.

projects.name: Tracelet
projects.desc: Zero-dependency log analyzer that pinpoints exact code lines causing slowdowns in distributed cloud servers.
projects.long: Parses gigabytes of raw NDJSON distributed traces in seconds, computing the critical path and surfacing latency bottlenecks without heavy cloud APM agents.

projects.name: LoraMesh
projects.desc: Simulator for off-grid radio mesh networks modeling emergency communication during power outages.
projects.long: Simulates packet propagation, duty cycles, and airtime limits for long-range LoRa radios across disaster zones in pure Python standard library.

projects.name: BlinkSpan
projects.desc: Network simulator injecting artificial lag and packet drops to stress-test multiplayer games and financial apps.
projects.long: Deterministic link simulator allowing developers to reproduce terrible Wi-Fi and mobile network conditions reliably in automated CI/CD test suites.

projects.name: EchoPrint
projects.desc: Cybersecurity network scanner in 500 lines of pure Python that identifies remote operating systems without nmap.
projects.long: Fingerprints remote servers and operating systems by analyzing subtle TCP/IP handshake quirks, TTL defaults, and window parameters without external scanners.

projects.name: Prompt Shield
projects.desc: Security scanner evaluating prompt injections and hacker jailbreaks on AI chatbots in under one millisecond.
projects.long: Defends enterprise AI applications from adversarial prompt attacks and hidden instruction smuggling with 18+ high-speed heuristic detectors.

projects.name: WhisperVault
projects.desc: 100% private in-browser notebook that runs AI search and chat on your personal notes without sending data to servers.
projects.long: Uses client-side WebGPU to run language models directly on the user's graphics chip. All notes and vector search indices remain encrypted on your device.

projects.name: PyBox
projects.desc: Secure sandbox running untrusted Python code with strict CPU and memory limits without needing Docker.
projects.long: Uses Linux kernel seccomp filters and resource limits to safely execute user-submitted Python scripts with hard 50MB memory and 1-second timeout caps.

projects.name: BTC Research
projects.desc: Autonomous multi-agent research pipeline analyzing Bitcoin blockchain transactions, news, and market depth.
projects.long: Coordinates independent AI agents monitoring on-chain transaction velocity, order book bids, and macroeconomic announcements into unified signal feeds.

projects.name: Excel Node Engine
projects.desc: Modern desktop spreadsheet engine combining traditional grid calculation with visual drag-and-drop workflow nodes.
projects.long: Provides business analysts with an interactive node-graph execution pipeline, allowing multi-step financial models to run without messy cell formulas.
